parties: UltraTech Cement Limited; Solaris Horizon Energy Private Limited
headline: UltraTech Cement acquires Solaris Horizon Energy
sum: UltraTech Cement has announced an acquisition of Solaris Horizon Energy Private Limited, signalling strategic expansion into the renewable energy and green hydrogen sector to support cement manufacturing decarbonization.
implication: Cement sector acquisitions of renewable energy platforms signal regulatory momentum on ESG and Scope 1/2 emissions compliance under the Bharatmala and National Green Hydrogen Mission frameworks; material for RBI/SEBI ESG disclosure and consolidated sustainability reporting.
detail: UltraTech Cement Limited, India's largest cement manufacturer, has acquired Solaris Horizon Energy Private Limited, a renewable energy platform. The acquisition aligns with UltraTech's decarbonization roadmap and India's National Green Hydrogen Mission. The transaction was disclosed via NSE filing on 12 August 2026. Specific deal value, share structure and closing conditions remain subject to regulatory approval and detailed disclosure.
